tasks.name: 恢复剧情总结
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const file = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const input = document.createElement('input');
        input.type = 'file';
        input.accept = '.json';
        input.style.position = 'fixed';
        input.style.top = '-1000px';
        document.body.appendChild(input);
        let settled = false;
        const done = (fn, val) => { if (!settled) { settled = true; input.remove(); fn(val); } };
        input.addEventListener('change', () => done(resolve, input.files[0] || null));
        input.addEventListener('cancel', () => done(reject, new Error('已取消')));
        input.click();
    }).catch(e => { window.toastr?.warning(e.message || '未选择文件'); return null; });
    if (!file) return;

    let backup;
    try { backup = JSON.parse(await file.text()); } catch (e) { window.toastr?.error('JSON 解析失败'); return; }
    if (backup.type !== 'LittleWhiteBoxStorySummaryFullBackup' || !backup.storySummary) {
        window.toastr?.error('不是有效的剧情总结备份文件');
        return;
    }

    const storeMod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/store.js');
    const lexMod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/vector/retrieval/lexical-index.js');
    const ctx = (window.SillyTavern?.getContext)?.() ?? (await import('/scripts/extensions.js')).getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    if (!chatId) { window.toastr?.error('当前没有打开聊天'); return; }

    const store = storeMod.getSummaryStore();
    if (!store) { window.toastr?.error('无法读取总结存储'); return; }

    window.__summaryPreRestore = structuredClone(store);
    Object.assign(store, structuredClone(backup.storySummary));  // 整块覆盖
    store.updatedAt = Date.now();
    await storeMod.saveSummaryStoreImmediately(chatId);
    lexMod.invalidateLexicalIndex();

    console.log('[恢复] 完成 | 事件:', store.json?.events?.length ?? 0);
    console.log('[恢复] 恢复前状态已存 window.__summaryPreRestore');
    window.toastr?.success(`✅ 剧情总结已恢复（事件 ${store.json?.events?.length ?? 0} 条）| 建议跑向量补全`);
})();
<</taskjs>>
